source: BK6 printed pp.53-54 = book5-6.pdf PDF pp.59-60, image-read; errata.pdf p.4 (ER-42); Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect is derived by hand from the 44-wire topology (the 38-line basic sequence recognition circuit plus the p.53 example path 8-1-2-9-6-5) and the p.53 rule, tagged FALLBACK-DERIVED-TOPOLOGY. The play wire is script cord 44 from M+#1; each move re-ends it as a touch on the square's top terminal (p.54) and lifts it back to free. Derived cases: light 6 on at power-on and off after the start touch (O-C22); light 1 off before the solving touch; the goal touched first does nothing; a square outside the path (7) and a backtrack to a passed square do nothing; an out-of-order path square (6 after 8, 1, 2) drops every relay and lights light 6; after that error the full path succeeds again with no power cycle (O-C21 a, topology reading); the p.54 short path 8-9-4 (cords 45-47, wired with power off after removing path cords 38-43) with relays pushed one at a time: order 4, 5, 6 leaves only relay 6 held, so the start touch is an error; order 6, 5, 4 holds all three and the path succeeds, resumed without a power cycle (O-C21 b; the page gives no order). Indicator lamps are not asserted (a lit indicator lamp is in series with its coil). The p.54 dummy lines are not wired. Script choices, not printed: touch and lift settles of 500 ms, a 200 ms advance before each expect (O-C28), the 30 ms power-off advance, the 50 ms relay-push hold, and the error move.

script.cite: BK6 printed p.53 = book5-6.pdf PDF p.59 (rule and program); derived from topology: 1C..6C on minus (1C/2C..5C/6C, 6C/6-), so relay n's coil runs nF-coil-nE-indicator lamp-minus; hold chain 6H(+)-6G=6F, 5H=6G, 5G=5F, 4H=5G, 4G=4F, 3H=4G, 3G=3F, 2H=3G, 2G=2F, 1H=2G, 1G=1F=1A (light 1, 1B/1-); light 6 = 6H(+)-6J (relay 6 N.C.)-6A, 6B/6-; set 2 of relay k (k=2..6): arm kL = (k-1)com, N.O. kK = (k-1)F, N.C. kN on the error node 2N=3N=4N=5N=6N=6E; path squares 6com=M8t, 5com=M1t, 4com=M2t, 3com=M9t, 2com=M6t, 1com=M5t; the play wire puts + on the touched top terminal; + on 6E puts + on both ends of coil 6 (6F held at +), so relay 6 drops and the hold chain drops every lower relay; no + reaches any F (play wire free, every set-1 N.O. open), so every relay out; 6H(+)-6J-6A lights light 6 at full rail; 1A=1F unfed, light 1 off
script.quote: The object of this game is to find the correct path through the game matrix. Light 1 indicates success; light 6 indicates error and re-set.
